## Summary

- `packages/ui/src/run-card.tsx` — `runStateTone(state)` maps every `RUN_STATES`
  member to a chip `Tone` (in-flight→running, waiting→needs_you, delivered→ready,
  failed→attention, quiet→neutral); the header `Pill` carries `runStateLabel` +
  `data-state-tone`; the card root gains a per-tone left accent (`borderLeft: 3px
  solid TONE_ACCENT[tone]`); `ui-d-cap` dropped from the delivered heading; decisions
  render as `<li data-kind>` rows with a `ui-chip` kind badge + `decisionLine`.
- `packages/ui/src/primitives/chips.tsx` — `Pill` forwards `...rest` span props so the
  state hook lands; `packages/ui/src/gate-card.tsx` — same structured decision rows on
  `data-gate-decisions`.
- `apps/web/src/{copy.ts,dom-contract.ts,dossier-labels.tsx,gate-card.tsx}` —
  `deliveredHeading` → "Delivered"; `data-state-tone` declared; `data-kind` owner
  note extended; `decisionKindLabel` wired at both label sites.
- `packages/ui/src/run-card.test.tsx` — +144 lines: tone map, per-state DOM
  treatments, no-caps scans, structured decision rows.
